notes:
Customer profile: large EU fintech platform with monorepo + many private code repos (20TB raw source). Primary ask = low-latency code search + reliable reranking for precision over recall. Wants capability to re-index large code corpora frequently (nightly full, hourly deltas) and to run reranker inference close to the retriever to meet strict latency SLOs.

Key constraints / ask snippets from calls: 
- "We cannot expose source code off-prem — KMS + on-prem execution mandatory for any production inference."
- Wants SAML SSO + SCIM for team provisioning and audit-level logs for all queries.
- Target latency: p50 <= 100ms for retriever (vector lookup) and end-to-end p95 <= 750ms for retriever+reranker for most developer flows. High-throughput batch queries (CI/dev tools) expected at 400 qps peak.
- Index scale: initial PoC ~30M embeddings, target production 100M+ vectors; expect 15-30% monthly growth, heavy duplicates and binary blobs to filter.
- Cost sensitivity: wants cost per query under $0.015 avg with reranker enabled (or clear plan to trade batch windows vs cost).

Technical preferences / architecture notes: 
- Prefer code-specific embeddings (StarCoder embeddings or CodeBERT variants), willing to test Redwood-verified open models if performance matches.
- Reranking model: small cross-encoder (quantized) colocated with vector store; fallback to distilled model when load spikes.
- Strong interest in Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching profiles, quantization recommendations).
- Needs automatic prefix/KV caching for frequent developer queries (hot snippets).
- Re-index pipeline: CI triggers -> incremental embedding jobs -> dedupe & shingling -> verification set to catch regressions. Wants Redwood to support connector for internal artifact store and show per-route token cost in console.

PoC so far: 
- Indexed 4M sample vectors using Redwood test cluster; measured vector recall P@10 = 0.72, reranker improves P@10 to 0.86 on internal dev set.
- Measured end-to-end p95 ~1.2s with hosted configs; need to get under 750ms with dedicated/private.
- Trial cost projection indicates hosted api cost ~3x desired; leaning to dedicated / private for economics.
